prior_evidence: Stage 3 and stage 4 results plus phase A diagnostics are already known; this is a same-screen descriptive follow-up, not independent confirmation.
input_contract: Reuse the original hashed Hallmark NPZ and species-native GMTs; reproduce the four primary stage-4 grid cells before reporting new fits. Never overwrite historical outputs.
eligibility: Original 885 wells with positive deposited day-7/day-14 mean-area values and positive epithelial library total; fixed four target-removal settings.
block_interpretation: Operational decomposition of the existing six mouse growth scores; remaining_growth is not biologically non-proliferative. Correlated blocks and overlapping genes preclude attribution to isolated mechanisms.

outcome_scales.inherited_log2: Primary: log2(deposited day14 area + 1), with log2(deposited day7 area + 1).
outcome_scales.deposited_numeric: Prespecified sensitivity: untransformed deposited day14 and day7 values; no physical units or unlogged area interpretation is inferred.

evaluation.within_group: Leave one deposited plate-replicate group out. Centre predictors and outcome within each group, including the held-out group's observed mean. This deliberately retains the original within-observed-group estimand; it is not unseen-group prediction.
evaluation.plate_shift: Leave one entire plate out. No plate or target indicators and no outcome centring. All model centring/scaling parameters are learned on training plates only; held-out outcomes enter only error evaluation. This is joint plate/target-distribution transport, not prospective forecasting because RNA is concurrent.
evaluation.fit: Ordinary least squares with intercept, training-only feature standardization, drop training-zero-variance columns; no tuning, outcome-selected features or penalization.
evaluation.metrics: Record squared errors for each well and fold, mean squared error, and relative error reduction 1 - SSE_candidate/SSE_reference. Also report equal-fold mean relative reductions to expose well/variance weighting.

decisions.margin_scope: A pragmatic 2% reduction of the nominated baseline's held-out squared error on the same endpoint scale, not the old 0.02 delta-R2 threshold and not a biological importance margin.
decisions.within_group_margin_met: For a comparison, pooled relative error reduction >=0.02 in both primary and drop_both on both predeclared outcome scales. Report fold signs and the other two removals even if this rule passes.
decisions.consistent_plate_shift_gain: The within-group margin rule must also pass in the plate_shift evaluation, and every held-out plate must have a positive comparison increment in primary and drop_both on both outcome scales.
decisions.failure_scope: Failure is not precise absence of a biological role. No new block is added to rescue it; no per-gene mechanism is inferred.
decisions.question: If remaining_over_proliferation clears only the within-group rule, the signal contains information beyond the nominated proliferation block within groups but has not demonstrated consistent joint plate/target transport.

secondary_disposition: No new fibroblast or additional pathway expansion. Earlier secondary outputs remain descriptive full-baseline comparisons; no retrospective BH inference. All new model baselines are fixed explicitly rather than selected by an unimplemented winner rule.
uncertainty: No p/q values or biological confidence intervals because the independent preparation mapping is unresolved. Four plates are too few to establish generality; report all fold errors and signs instead.
stops: failure to reproduce original four-cell grid within 0.00005 rounding tolerance
non-finite inputs or failed library join
new outputs would overwrite existing files
